breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the dynamic amplification from a suddenly applied load; for a linear elastic bar, the peak stress is not the same as the static stress.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the dynamic amplification factor of 2 for a suddenly applied load, computing σ_max = 2 × (P/A) = 53.33 MPa. It explicitly rejects the flawed instruction that peak stress equals static stress P/A, instead using the energy method (work = strain energy) to derive δ_max = 2P/k, which yields twice the static stress. This aligns with the ground truth prompt, which omits the incorrect hint and asks the solver to properly use energy methods.
